integrity: The type/orbit bijection and top-chain reduction were reconstructed directly. An exhaustive finite-poset replay independently checks the admissibility characterization, the reduction identity, and sample closed forms; classical #P-hardness of antichain counting is cited rather than recomputed.
limitations: Completeness is established under polynomial-time Turing reductions using two oracle calls, not under parsimonious or single-query many-one reductions. The one-point-extension L/U characterization is prior work, and unindexed folklore priority for the complexity corollary remains possible.
title: Finite-parameter 1-type counting in the random poset is #P-complete
